metadata.description: DeepSeek 大肥鱼 video-making skills for Claude Code and compatible agents: hand-painted watercolour animation and kinetic-typography reels, every frame and every note generated in code. A DeepSeek-themed derivative of opus-video-skills (MIT).

plugins.name: painted-animation
plugins.description: Hand-painted watercolour-and-ink cartoons and lyric videos starring 大肥鱼 (the DeepSeek fat fish girl): p5.js + p5.brush, rendered frame by frame in headless Chrome, with storyboarding, character acting, beat sync and (opt-in) karaoke.

plugins.name: kinetic-reel
plugins.description: DeepSeek 深海 kinetic-typography motion reels: bold condensed type, HUD micro-type, three.js generative water layers (particle deep, caustic currents, a bent-drop fish mark, a particle school), shape-continuity transitions and a synthesized beat-locked score.
